citation: City of Chicago, Department of Innovation and Technology. Street Center Lines (Transportation.geojson), osd-street-center-line release, last edited 2014-10-15.
author: City of Chicago

note: TODAY'S streets, not historical evidence. Supplies the present-day street names, centrelines and block address ranges the compass readout and the overview map show under every year (T-2741), so a visitor knows the modern street and house number they stand at. Nothing in a period layer is read off it or traced from it.
locator: data/modern/streets.json, clipped and projected by tools/build_modern_streets.py
what_it_supplies: Modern street names and centreline geometry for downtown and the near South Side
Each segment's grid coordinate (EWNS) and its block's address ranges, left and right
what_it_does_not_supply: Renames after 2014 (Ida B. Wells Dr, DuSable Lake Shore Dr), which the tool applies and lists in the clip
